overrides.adjustmentNote: Dynamic Discs publishes Trespass at 12/5/-0.5/3. Atlas moves turn half a step (-0.5 to -1); speed 12, glide 5 and fade 3 stay unchanged. The supplied batch-8 research records Infinite Discs reviewer-average turn -1.1 on the whole-mold page (177 ratings), Lucid (71) and Fuzion (38). Lucid and Fuzion are premium plastics. All three averages move away from the displayed -0.5 toward more turn, so simple agreement with the displayed rating cannot explain the direction; this does not measure or eliminate every possible review bias. Reviewers in the batch-8 sample report throwing distances of 300-400+ ft and compare Trespass with Wraith and Destroyer flights. Counter-evidence: the manufacturer still prints -0.5; the overall average pools plastics, and the plastic-specific subsets overlap the overall pool rather than providing three independent samples. DGCR threads were unreadable. The owner approved turn -0.5 to -1 on October 3, 2026. Confidence 0.65. No cross-plastic averaging was performed, and plastic, run, weight and wear differences remain. Wraith and Destroyer are unchanged; review them together with Trespass if its rating moves again.
